required_facts_checked: The second cohort built personal assistants, professional tools and health-related assistants.
Eduardo Gonzalo Almorox's bAIpacking Agent uses DotWatcher, PostgreSQL, FastAPI, Reflex, RAG and offline judge scoring.
Pavlo Skorodziievskyi's Meal-Map uses four nutrition sources chunked into 28 documents and nine tools, with 20-request and $0.50 daily limits.
Camila Gaitan Mosquera's Decision Memory Agent indexed around 21 documents in ChromaDB and returns structured decision context with monitoring.
Mladen Maric's VoiceIssue Agent creates GitHub issues from Telegram voice, asks for confirmation and uses Docker Compose, dashboards and an LLM judge.
Spyros Koumarianos's medical app uses local Whisper, diarisation and local Llama offline; a three-minute recording takes around ten minutes without GPUs.
Nirajan Acharya's Cyber Sachet supports Nepali cybersecurity awareness in English and Nepali with citations, Logfire and an LLM judge.
James Watkins's SnapSplit uses vision for receipts and escalates OCR mismatches to human review.
Juan Perez Prim's AMR platform ingests 15 sources including WHO, CDC, FAO, PubMed and Our World in Data and combines BM25 with BioBERT through reciprocal-rank fusion.
Léonore Tideman's regulation assistant covers European, US and Dutch jurisdictions and uses scope guarding, local retrieval, Brave Search, Jina Reader, Ansvar, integration tests and an LLM judge.
